cards.text: Right after David's last words (2 Samuel 23:1), the writer lists the names of David's mighty men. First up is Josheb-basshebeth the Tahchemonite, chief of the Three. Friend, a kitchen timer goes off and I jump so high my gold base comes WITH me.

cards.question: Josheb-basshebeth wields his spear. How many men does he kill, all at one time?

cards.text: Next in command is Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men. He goes with David to taunt the Philistines who have gathered for battle at Pas-dammim.
The men of Israel retreat, backing away like they just remembered they left the oven on at home.

cards.question: Israel's troops are pulling back from the Philistines. What does Eleazar do?

cards.text: Eleazar stands his ground and strikes the Philistines until his hand grows weary and sticks to his sword.

cards.question: After a day like that, the passage says ___ brought about a great victory.
Once the LORD brings the victory, the troops who retreated come back to Eleazar, but only to ___ the dead.

cards.text: They skip the whole fight and show up for the spoils, like coworkers who dodge the project and then show up for the cookie box. And after Eleazar comes Shammah son of Agee the Hararite.

cards.question: The Philistines band together near a field full of lentils. True or false: Israel's troops flee from them.
Israel's troops have fled from the Philistines near the lentil field. Where does Shammah take his stand?

answers.text: In the middle of the field
At the edge of the field
On the road past the field

cards.question: Shammah takes his stand in the middle of the lentil field and defends it. True or false: The Philistines take the field from him in the end.

cards.text: Shammah strikes down the Philistines. So the LORD brings about a great victory.
Now here's a story from harvest time. Three of the thirty chief men go down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines is camped in the Valley of Rephaim.

cards.question: David is in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines is at ___.

cards.text: Then David longs for water, and he says it out loud: "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"

cards.question: David wishes out loud for water from Bethlehem, where the Philistines hold a garrison. So the three mighty men ___ the Philistine camp.

cards.text: They break through the Philistine camp, draw water from that well and bring it back to David. That's like you sighing "I wish I had my phone charger," and three coworkers drive through rush hour to go get it.

cards.question: Three men just broke through the Philistine camp for one drink of water. True or false: David drinks it.
David refuses the water his three men brought from Bethlehem. What does he do with it instead?

answers.text: Pours it out to the LORD
Gives it back to the three
Saves it for the next battle

cards.question: David pours the water out to the LORD. Why won't he drink it?

answers.text: His men risked their lives for it
He fears the well is poisoned
He vowed to fast until evening

cards.text: David says, "Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this! Is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives?" Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
Back to the honor roll, friend. Next is Abishai son of Zeruiah, chief of the Three, and he's got a spear of his own.

cards.question: Abishai son of Zeruiah is the brother of ___, David's army commander (2 Samuel 8:16).
Abishai wields his spear against a crowd of men and kills them. How many?

cards.text: Three hundred, and Abishai wins a name along with the Three. Then the passage asks, "Was he not more honored than the Three?"
Abishai becomes their commander, even though he's not included among the Three. That's like being made admin of a group chat you were never added to.
Next up is Benaiah son of Jehoiada, a man of valor from Kabzeel and a man of many exploits. He strikes down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he goes down into a pit.

cards.question: On a snowy day, Benaiah goes down into a pit and kills a ___.

cards.text: He goes down into a pit on a SNOWY day, and I hit snooze when the kitchen's a little chilly. Then there's an Egyptian, a huge man with a spear in his hand.

cards.question: The huge Egyptian has a spear in his hand, and Benaiah has only a club. True or false: Benaiah goes against him anyway.
Benaiah goes at the spear-holding Egyptian with just a club. How does he win?

answers.text: Snatches the spear and uses it
Knocks him down with the club
Calls in the guard to help

cards.text: Benaiah snatches the spear right out of the Egyptian's hand and kills him with his own spear. These are Benaiah's exploits, and he wins a name along with the three mighty men.

cards.question: True or false: With all those exploits, Benaiah becomes one of the Three.
Benaiah is the most honored among the Thirty, but not one of the Three. What does David put him over?

cards.text: Then comes the list of the Thirty, starting with Asahel, Joab's brother. The very last name is Uriah the Hittite, Bathsheba's husband, whose death David arranged (2 Samuel 11:3, 14-17). Thirty-seven in all.
